Received and merged exact head `68630f0e624206ddbe2a1e01c521716787bb5764` as `e09d7b40e64e099ef388a84465994e407d4b3b14`, preserving the concurrent PR #5 documentation.

Actual [public CI attempt 2](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios-news-site/actions/runs/39678446509/attempts/2) passed the original five structured-data tests and all 168 current application tests, with zero failures or skips. The job reports its actual PNPM store as `data/logs/publisher-entity-ci-logs/pnpm-store/v11`.

Attempt 1 failed during dependency installation with registry HTTP 502; it ran no tests. The single rerun followed an independently received recovery of the original registry under its owning section data directory.

Immutable package publication, current Koios application selection, guarded Guix/Cloudflare release and live publisher-linkage receiving remain owed through the [current newsroom operation](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios.news/issues/40).
